derivation: from a presumed compound of G5550 (χρόνος) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος);
def: to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger)

occurrences.text: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
